```yaml
name: Close Old Bot Discussions

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  create-issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Create Issue
        id: create-issue
        run: |
          go run ./cmd/create-issue/main.go --repo=github/gh-aw --title="New Issue" --body="This is a new issue"
        env:
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ steps.create-issue.outputs.issue_number }}

  link_sub_issue:
    needs: create-issue
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Link Sub Issue
        run: |
          go run ./cmd/link-sub-issue/main.go --repo=github/gh-aw --parent-issue=${{ needs.create-issue.outputs.ISSUE_NUMBER }} --sub-issue=123

  close-old-bot-discussions:
    needs: link_sub_issue
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Close Old Bot Discussions
        run: |
          go run ./cmd/close-old-bot-discussions/main.go --repo=github/gh-aw
```
